resources.string: Quick Tap: tap each cookie as fast as you can
Swift Slice: slice the falling cookies with a swipe
Steady Spiral: guide the cookie out of the tunnel
When a cookie appears, tap it as quickly as you can.

Cookies will fall from the top of the screen. Slice each one by swiping or flicking your finger across it, like a knife, before it reaches the bottom. Cut right through the middle for bonus points. Slice 3 in a row and the cookies fall faster!
The cookie is stuck in the middle of a spiral tunnel. Put your finger on it and slowly slide it all the way to the EXIT. Try not to touch the walls, and collect the sprinkles on the way.
